tools.name: semantic_search_nodes_tool
tools.intent: Find code by describing what it does, when you do not know the file or symbol name. The entry point for 'where is X handled?'.

tools.name: query_graph_tool
tools.intent: Trace a known symbol's callers, callees, imports or covering tests — the structural answer a text search cannot give.

tools.name: detect_changes_tool
tools.intent: List what changed since the last graph update, as the starting point of a review rather than a git diff.

tools.name: get_impact_radius_tool
tools.intent: Blast radius of editing a symbol: everything downstream that a change to it can reach.

tools.name: get_architecture_overview_tool
tools.intent: Orientation in an unfamiliar repository — its structure and major components — before reading any single file.
